correctness.rationale: For every odd prime power q, the quadratic x²−tx+a=0 has a nonzero root iff discriminant u−4a is a square, so B_(a,u)=1_Q(u−4a). Summing over nonzero 4a gives G_uu=(q−1)/2=h and G_uv=[q−3+(1+chi(-1))chi(u−v)]/4 for distinct u,v in Q. The quadratic autocorrelation sum is −1. If q=3 mod4 the Gram is (q+1)I/4+(q−3)J/4, yielding ((q²−1)/8 once,(q+1)/4 with multiplicity h). If q=1 mod4, separate zero and H squares: the constant block has eigenvalues h(h+2±sqrt(h²+4))/4, nonconstant multiplicative characters of H give (h+1)/2+(1/2)sum_H psi(t)chi(1−t). Gauss–Jacobi magnitudes imply strict positivity (q>1), so B has full column rank. Independently constructed reciprocal images and Gram entries for seven prime fields and checked spectral ranks; finite enumeration corroborates the all-prime-power argument.
